name: bshift
title: ROX-BSHIFT — 16-bit barrel shifter
description: Build a 16-bit barrel shifter: dir=0 shift left, dir=1 shift right; arith=1 arithmetic (sign-extend) else logical; sh is the shift amount. Combinational. Testbench prints bshift:PASS.
context: Pure combinational. For left shifts fill with 0. Right shift logical fills 0; arithmetic replicates bit15. sh in 0..15. Testbench CHECKs: din=16'h000F, dir=0, arith=0, sh=4 -> 16'h00F0; din=16'h8000, dir=1, arith=1, sh=1 -> 16'hC000; din=16'h8000, dir=1, arith=0, sh=1 -> 16'h4000; din=16'hFFFF, dir=0, sh=8 -> 16'hFF00. print bshift:PASS.

manifest.ports: input [15:0] din, input [3:0] sh, input dir, input arith, output reg [15:0] dout
manifest.behavior: 15h0 with dir0 sh4 -> 00F0; 8000 dir1 arith1 sh1 -> C000; 8000 dir1 arith0 sh1 -> 4000; FFFF dir0 sh8 -> FF00. print bshift:PASS if all match.
